items.description:
**Dify 1.20.0 keeps your traces flowing and your knowledge bases safer.** Export traces to any OpenTelemetry collector, keep Langfuse working after its legacy ingestion endpoint retirement, and scan uploaded knowledge files for malware before they are indexed. Chatflows can show Agent tool activity as it happens, and personal access tokens let scripts and agents call the Dify OpenAPI on your behalf. The bundled plugin daemon is upgraded to **0.6.15-local**.

items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.17
items.description:
## Inkling 2 Mini
[Inkling 2 Mini](https://ollama.com/library/inkling-2-mini) from Thinking Machines is a 26B parameter model with 5.4B active.

Its looped layers give it more computation per token than its size suggests, and it still fits on a Mac at about 20GB. It handles text and images, tool calls, and thinking, and scores 79.2% on SWE-Bench Verified).

```
  ollama run inkling-2-mini
```

items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.16
items.description:
## Ripple Preview

[Ripple Preview](https://ollama.com/library/ripple-preview) from Ricursive Intelligence is a 65B dense model built for agentic coding.

```sh
ollama run ripple-preview
```

## What's Changed

- Qwen3.8 Flash Next uses about 27 GiB less memory on Apple silicon
- `ollama launch claude` always routes Claude Code to the selected model
- `ollama launch` explains when a cloud model has been retired
- `/v1/responses` respects `truncation` and no longer silently truncates

items.name: ollama/ollama v0.40.15
items.description:
## MiMo V2.6

Xiaomi MiMo's [mimo-v2.6](https://ollama.com/library/mimo-v2.6), a 9B model built for code and agent workflows, is now supported in Ollama.

```sh
ollama run mimo-v2.6
```
